title: Democrats, younger adults and urban residents are more open to purchasing an electric vehicle
Americans have low levels of confidence that the U.S. will build necessary EV infrastructure
People who are confident U.S. will build charging infrastructure are more likely to consider an EV purchase
Support for phasing out new gasoline vehicles by 2035 has decreased over the past 2 years
73% of Republicans say they would be upset if the U.S. stopped making new gasoline vehicles
